## Estado atual — M273 (2026-09-11)

  isolamento tenant e validação de uso/versões; requirement `HS-AI-018`.

--- AGENTS ---
# HandStack - instrucoes de continuidade

Leia STATUS.md primeiro. A especificacao indicada pelo supervisor e a fonte de verdade;
docs/requirements/catalog.yaml e o catalogo existente de rastreabilidade. Nao crie catalogos concorrentes.
Mantenha STATUS.md curto: estado atual, requisito em andamento, bloqueios, evidencia e proximo passo.
Acrescente o historico detalhado em HISTORY.md. Consulte apenas os trechos historicos pertinentes.
Releia cada arquivo antes de editar. Preserve trabalho existente e use incrementos verificaveis. Execute apenas testes focais relacionados aos arquivos alterados. Nao abra nem audite vitest.config.*, vitest.workspace.ts ou configuracoes de teste em incrementos que nao alterem testes; deixe o Vitest completo para o gate final. Limite a diagnostico de ambiente a uma sondagem curta por turno; nao execute o gerenciador legado do lockfile, nao repita npm/yarn nem crie scripts temporarios de probe.
Confirme o estado real do ambiente antes de adotar um bloqueio registrado em STATUS.md/HISTORY.md; esses arquivos podem estar desatualizados. Execute verificacoes focais para mudancas locais; gates globais quando houver impacto transversal ou na conclusao.
Gates de conclusao: execute format:check, docs:validate, lint, typecheck, test e build usando npm; use yarn somente se yarn.lock existir.
Respeite a matriz de runtime do projeto. Testes offline nao certificam integracoes com servicos reais.
Declare bloqueios externos explicitamente, mas continue com incrementos locais seguros que nao dependam da infraestrutura indisponivel. Nao repita o mesmo bloqueio sem nova sondagem. Se a recuperacao falhar uma vez, avance para codigo, contratos, documentacao ou testes focados. Nao crie arquivos temporarios de sondagem nem `.handstack-codex/COMPLETE`: pertence ao supervisor.
O gerenciador e o lockfile legados deste projeto nao devem ser executados, instalados ou usados para escolher comandos; use npm e, quando houver yarn.lock, yarn. Nao altere o lockfile legado apenas para contornar uma falha de ambiente.
Nao edite o supervisor nem seus logs/contadores. Detalhe falhas e proximos passos no ledger.


--- CATALOG ---
    acceptanceCriteria: Accounts issue with unique safe scopes, authenticate as SERVICE_ACCOUNT, isolate organizations, reject invalid credentials, rotate and invalidate old secrets, expire, revoke and list without exposing secret material.
    testIds: [HS-T-M45-SERVICE-ACCOUNT-001, HS-T-M45-SERVICE-ACCOUNT-002]
    testPaths: [packages/service-accounts/tests/service-accounts.test.ts]
    documentationArticleIds: [getting-started/service-accounts]
    introducedVersion: 0.43.0
  - id: HS-SEC-020
    title: Secure SAML and LDAP identity provider contracts
    normativeStatement: HandStack MUST provide specialized SAML 2.0 and LDAP/LDAPS identity provider contracts with injected verification/transports, HTTPS or LDAPS enforcement, tenant-scoped identities, bounded timeouts, anti-replay for assertions and secret references instead of inline credentials.
    rationale: Enterprise SSO needs protocol-specific security boundaries without coupling the identity domain to a vendor SDK or silently treating Entra ID and traditional Active Directory as the same protocol.
    owner: identity-team
    status: implemented
    risk: critical
    affectedModules: [packages/plugin-saml/src/index.ts, packages/plugin-ldap/src/index.ts]
    publicContracts:
      [SamlIdentityProvider, SamlResponseVerifier, ReplayStore, LdapIdentityProvider, LdapTransport]
    dataEntities: [SamlAssertion, LdapUser]
    securityPrivacyImpact: SAML signatures are delegated to an explicit verifier and consumed assertions are replay-protected; LDAP requires LDAPS and secret references, never inline passwords. Offline contracts do not certify a real identity provider, certificate chain or directory.
    acceptanceCriteria: SAML rejects insecure endpoints, invalid tenant/provider scope, expired or replayed assertions, and bounded verification failures; LDAP rejects non-LDAPS endpoints and inline credentials, uses an injected transport, maps users to the configured organization and closes the transport after each attempt.
    testIds: [HS-T-M46-SAML-001, HS-T-M46-LDAP-001]
    testPaths: [packages/plugin-saml/tests/saml.test.ts, packages/plugin-ldap/tests/ldap.test.ts]
    documentationArticleIds: [getting-started/enterprise-identity-protocols]
    introducedVersion: 0.44.0
  - id: HS-SEC-021
    title: Identity plugin contract test kit
    normativeStatement: HandStack MUST provide an official identity plugin test kit that validates manifest, apiVersion, permissions, configuration schema, tenant isolation, timeout, fail-closed behavior, secret leakage prevention and applicable protocol capabilities through deterministic probes.
    rationale: Identity extensions must preserve the authorization, tenant, privacy and audit boundaries before activation, without requiring live external providers in every test run.
    owner: identity-team
    status: implemented
    risk: high
    affectedModules: [packages/plugin-testkit/src/index.ts]
    publicContracts:
      [
        IdentityPluginManifest,
        IdentityPluginContractProbe,
        IdentityPluginContractReport,
        verifyIdentityPluginContract,
        identityPluginContractSuites,
      ]
    dataEntities: []
    securityPrivacyImpact: Required probes make tenant isolation, bounded operations, fail-closed behavior and secret leakage explicit; deterministic offline checks do not certify external IdPs or directories.
    acceptanceCriteria: Invalid manifests and failed security/protocol probes throw a typed contract error; passing plugins receive a report listing all executed checks and declared capabilities.
    testIds: [HS-T-M47-PLUGIN-TESTKIT-001, HS-T-M47-PLUGIN-TESTKIT-002]
    testPaths: [packages/plugin-testkit/tests/identity.test.ts]
    documentationArticleIds: [getting-started/identity-plugin-testkit]
    introducedVersion: 0.45.0
